[EVENT] User purchased a set of 10 eco-friendly training pads from Chewy.com for $25 about a month ago.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The training pads from Chewy.com are a great choice for potty training.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommendations for potty-training aids include:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Potty Bells: Teach Luna to ring a bell when she needs to go outside.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Potty Pads with Attractant: Some pads have a built-in attractant, like those from PetSafe.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Outdoor Potty Areas: Designate a specific outdoor area for Luna to go potty.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Cleaning Products: Use an enzyme-based cleaner like Nature's Miracle to remove accidents.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for potty training include:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Establish a Schedule: Stick to a consistent feeding and potty schedule.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Supervise, Supervise, Supervise: Keep an eye on Luna to catch accidents.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Praise and Reward: Use positive reinforcement when she uses the potty correctly.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Watch for Signs: Take her to the potty area if she sniffs or circles.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Be Patient: Accidents are part of the learning process.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Gradually Increase Freedom: Give her more freedom as she becomes reliable.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Every puppy is different, so tailor the approach to Luna's needs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Consult with a veterinarian or professional dog trainer if needed.
